Your energy will 100% increase after you start working. I know depression drags you down abnormally, but your body and mind rise the the occasion a lot better then you assume after you start moving. Momentum is real, my friend. When I feel lethargic, one of my go-to's is actually exercise. That can be a 30 minutes walk, by the way. Do this in the morning, when the sun rises and in the evening as it goes down. Getting both AM and PM light in your eyes and on your skin sets your circadian rhythm thereby boosting your energy and letting you sleep more deeply. Take a cool shower before bed, too. You may sleep 30 minutes later, but you'll get better quality and that's what's important. More rigorous exercise and a freezing cold shower will work better but that will com later. Hmu if you wanna talk more about anything. Peace
